newsitem.title: JAPAN: Currencies should reflect fundamentals -- BOJ.
newsitem.headline: Currencies should reflect fundamentals -- BOJ.

text.p: Currencies should move in a stable manner and reflect countries' economic fundamentals, Bank of Japan governor Yasuo Matsushita told a business symposium on Tuesday.
He said recent foreign exchange movements had been rather rapid and the central bank needed to monitor the situation closely.
"Currencies should reflect the fundamentals of each nation and it is desirable that they move in a stable manner," he said.
Matsushita also said that although the BOJ highly regards the government's policy of deregulating the forex market, deregulation in other financial sectors had to be carried out swiftly as well.
"Unless other deregulation measures are carried out quickly, the reform of the foreign exchange laws may invite an outflow of financial transactions and lead to a hollowing out of the Tokyo market."
